summary: Colour p by its moved frame F_p ∈ V: distinct frames are 1/(N·boxSize)-separated and bounded, so there are at most b^{6n² dim V} colours; within a colour the cutoffs β_{k_p} sum to at most 1. Separation comes from integrality: close frames force equal frames, by a descending induction over the entries.

It remains to bound the sum over a related set B.
